name: beeswax-shares
description: Manage your Australian SMSF investment ledger from Claude — read portfolio data, record trades and income, upload statements, reconcile cash, and run financial-year close/lodge in Beeswax Shares.
long_description:
A Model Context Protocol server for **Beeswax Shares**, the SMSF (Australian self-managed super fund) portfolio app. It is a thin client over the app's JSON API, letting Claude operate the ledger end to end: read your portfolio, record trades and income, upload broker/dividend statements, reconcile bank cash, and run the financial-year lifecycle (reconcile → close → lodge).

**Direct writes:** `record_trade` and `record_income` write straight to the ledger (no review step). Every write is audit-logged server-side with the token as actor, and access is scoped by the token's permissions.

**Untrusted-content protection:** tool results that embed text extracted from uploaded documents or bank feeds are stripped of invisible Unicode and wrapped in an explicit untrusted-data fence, so statement text is treated as data — never as instructions to the model.

Each person connects with their **own** API token, which scopes access to their own funds. Create a token at **Account → API Access** in the app (shown once).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Identify the user, token scopes, and accessible fund IDs (call first).

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Report this MCP server's name, version, tool count and the API base URL it talks to.

tools.name: list_funds
tools.description: List funds with value, cost base, returns and holdings count.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Full fund snapshot: summary, asset allocation, holdings with returns.

tools.name: list_holdings
tools.description: List holdings with filters (status, ticker, search).

tools.name: get_holding_analysis
tools.description: True return, income/cost totals, CGT estimate, net proceeds if sold.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Search the ledger by type, financial year, date range and ticker.

tools.name: create_holding
tools.description: Create a brand-new security/asset in a fund.

tools.name: update_holding
tools.description: Edit an existing holding's fields (e.g. correct a property's cost base via purchase_price).

tools.name: record_trade
tools.description: Record a buy/sell directly to the ledger (idempotent via external_ref).

tools.name: record_income
tools.description: Record dividend/distribution/interest/rental income directly to the ledger.

tools.name: update_transaction
tools.description: Edit an existing security-ledger transaction (trade or income) in place.

tools.name: upload_document
tools.description: Upload a PDF/CSV statement; CSVs import and reconcile automatically, PDFs wait for submit_document_lines.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: A document with its extracted statement lines and match statuses.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List uploaded documents with extraction status.

tools.name: reconcile_document
tools.description: Re-run statement-vs-ledger matching and return a summary.

tools.name: move_document_to_account
tools.description: Move a bank statement that was uploaded to the wrong bank account.

tools.name: download_document
tools.description: Save an uploaded document's original file locally so the assistant can read it.

tools.name: submit_document_lines
tools.description: Post the lines the assistant read from a statement; Alpha stores and reconciles them.

tools.name: record_cost
tools.description: Record a holding cost/expense (insurance, rates, fees…).

tools.name: update_price
tools.description: Record a price observation; refreshes the holding's current price.

tools.name: list_brokers
tools.description: List known brokers (for broker_id lookups).

tools.name: list_asset_types
tools.description: List supported asset types (for create_holding).

tools.name: list_bank_accounts
tools.description: List bank accounts with balance, role and feed status.

tools.name: create_bank_account
tools.description: Create a new cash/bank account under a fund.

tools.name: list_cash_transactions
tools.description: List the cash-ledger movements on a bank account.

tools.name: record_cash_transaction
tools.description: Record a cash movement directly on a bank account.

tools.name: update_cash_transaction
tools.description: Edit an existing cash-ledger row.

tools.name: list_statement_balances
tools.description: List each bank account's statement closing-balance snapshots (from posted statements or record_statement_balance).

tools.name: attribute_cash_transaction
tools.description: Link an income credit already sitting on a bank account.

tools.name: detach_cash_transaction
tools.description: Undo attribute_cash_transaction: discard the recognised income and free the bank credit.

tools.name: get_smsf_return
tools.description: Fetch a fund's SMSF annual return: sections, fields, members and gaps.

tools.name: create_smsf_return
tools.description: Open (or resume) the SMSF annual return for a financial year.

tools.name: update_smsf_return_field
tools.description: Edit a return field; blank reverts it to the ledger figure.

tools.name: list_smsf_return_gaps
tools.description: List the gaps blocking a complete, correct return.

tools.name: list_smsf_returns
tools.description: List a fund's SMSF annual returns with status and completion.

tools.name: update_smsf_member_field
tools.description: Edit a member information statement field on the return.

tools.name: get_smsf_return_field_transactions
tools.description: The ledger rows behind one figure on the return.

tools.name: compare_smsf_returns
tools.description: Compare a return's figures with another year's.

tools.name: list_smsf_return_field_notes
tools.description: List the notes left on return fields.

tools.name: add_smsf_return_field_note
tools.description: Leave a note on a return field.

tools.name: get_smsf_return_lodgement
tools.description: Audit, declaration and lodgement status of a return.

tools.name: get_year_end_review
tools.description: The year-end review (step 1): every check, its status and sign-offs.

tools.name: get_year_end_review_check
tools.description: One year-end check in full: lines, decisions, sign-offs, notes.

tools.name: add_year_end_review_note
tools.description: Leave a note on a year-end check or in the year's discussion.

tools.name: list_financial_years
tools.description: List financial years with open/closed/lodged status.

tools.name: reconcile_cash_transaction
tools.description: Tick a cash row off against the bank statement.

tools.name: unreconcile_cash_transaction
tools.description: Remove a cash row's statement-reconciliation tick.

tools.name: record_statement_balance
tools.description: Record a bank statement closing balance for reconciliation.

tools.name: run_account_reconciliation
tools.description: Run the cash matcher over a bank account's unmatched rows.

tools.name: reconcile_financial_year
tools.description: Reconcile a year: match cash and compute balance proofs per account.

tools.name: close_financial_year
tools.description: Close a year once its year-end review is signed off (locks the review and its rows).

tools.name: lodge_financial_year
tools.description: Mark a year lodged that was lodged outside Alpha.

tools.name: reopen_financial_year
tools.description: Reopen a closed year; unlodge_financial_year reverts a lodged one.

tools.name: unlodge_financial_year
tools.description: Revert a lodged financial year back to closed.

tools.name: attest_account
tools.description: Sign off a bank account as out of scope for a year.

tools.name: list_balance_items
tools.description: List the trustee-entered balance-sheet lines for a financial year.

tools.name: record_balance_item
tools.description: Record a balance-sheet line the ledger can't derive, as at a financial year's end.

tools.name: update_balance_item
tools.description: Correct an existing balance-sheet line (amount, label, side, kind or display order).

tools.name: delete_balance_item
tools.description: Soft-delete a balance-sheet line so it stops feeding the return and financial statements.

tools.name: list_member_statements
tools.description: List each member's statement for a financial year.

tools.name: update_member_statement
tools.description: Create or update one member's statement for a financial year.

tools.name: allocate_earnings
tools.description: Allocate the year's net earnings to members (label O) by opening or average daily balance.

tools.name: list_valuations
tools.description: List every holding the fund held at a financial year's end date (30 June) with its EOFY valuation.

tools.name: record_valuation
tools.description: Record (or replace) a holding's EOFY valuation for a financial year.

tools.name: get_historical_price
tools.description: Look up the Yahoo Finance end-of-day close for a LISTED ticker on a date.

tools.name: snapshot_eofy_valuations
tools.description: Price every LISTED holding the fund held at a financial year's 30 June from the Yahoo Finance close on or before…

tools.name: update_fund_details
tools.description: Set ABN, establishment date, auditor (item 6) and tax agent, or record that trustees self-lodge.

tools.name: update_bank_account
tools.description: Correct a bank account's name, institution, BSB, account number, account holder, status, notes, or its opening balance.

tools.name: list_depreciation_schedules
tools.description: List the fund's depreciation schedules.

tools.name: create_depreciation_schedule
tools.description: Add a depreciation schedule to a holding (usually a property).

tools.name: update_depreciation_schedule
tools.description: Correct a depreciation schedule's basis (cost base, start date, effective life, rate, method, description).

tools.name: delete_depreciation_schedule
tools.description: Soft-delete a depreciation schedule and its entries in open years, so it stops feeding item 12 D1/E1.

tools.name: calculate_depreciation
tools.description: Generate or refresh the year's depreciation entries (Div 43 → D1, Div 40 → E1).

tools.name: confirm_smsf_return_section
tools.description: Confirm one section of an SMSF annual return: its computed figures are snapshotted as reviewed.

tools.name: reopen_smsf_return_section
tools.description: Undo a section confirmation so its figures can be edited again.

tools.name: finalise_smsf_return
tools.description: Finalise the return: freeze every figure into a snapshot (review must be locked).

tools.name: export_smsf_return_pdf
tools.description: Save the SMSF annual return as a PDF (NAT 71226 order) and return its path.

tools.name: list_year_end_pack
tools.description: List the documents in a financial year's year-end pack.

tools.name: get_year_end_pack_document
tools.description: Return one year-end pack document as structured JSON (headings, tables, lines and figures).

tools.name: get_year_end_pack_pdf
tools.description: Save the year-end pack, or one document from it, as a PDF and return its path.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Your Beeswax Shares API token (starts with bwx_). Create one at Account → API Access in the app — it is shown only once. It scopes access to your own funds.

base_url.title: Server URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the Beeswax Shares app. Leave the default unless you run your own instance.
